description: Angular component for a numeric filter predicate UI, allowing users to select numeric operations and values for filtering in the Thingsboard platform.

classes.name: NumericFilterPredicateComponent
classes.description: Angular component implementing a numeric filter predicate with form controls, validation, and change propagation.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes the form group and sets up value change subscription.

methods.name: registerOnChange
methods.description: Registers a callback function to propagate changes.

methods.name: registerOnTouched
methods.description: Placeholder for registering touch callback (not implemented).

methods.name: setDisabledState
methods.description: Enables or disables the form controls based on input.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the form group and returns validation errors if invalid.

methods.name: writeValue
methods.description: Patches form controls with provided predicate values.

methods.name: updateModel
methods.description: Updates the predicate model and propagates change.
